name: qcyc-outlier-height-check
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,targets=[[1234.4,2166.2],[1212,2181.4],[1215.2,2191]];const report=[];for(const [x,z] of targets){const r=C.GEO.buildings.find(b=>Math.abs(b[0]-x)<.01&&Math.abs(b[1]-z)<.01);const p=C.islandBuildingProfile(r);if(!p||p.height>=10||p.typology==='cottage')throw Error('Marina outlier unresolved/misclassified '+x+','+z);const cs=Math.cos(r[2]),sn=Math.sin(r[2]);let n=0;for(const [u0,u1,v0,v1]of r[3]){const hx=(u1-u0)/2,hz=(v1-v0)/2;if(hx<.5||hz<.5)continue;const u=(u0+u1)/2,v=(v0+v1)/2,cx=x+u*cs+v*sn,cz=z-u*sn+v*cs;const co=a.controllerManager.colliders.find(c=>c.obb&&Math.hypot(c.obb.cx-cx,c.obb.cz-cz)<.02&&Math.abs(c.obb.hx-hx)<.02&&Math.abs(c.obb.hz-hz)<.02);if(!co||co.maxY>=10)throw Error('Tall/missing marina collider '+x+','+z);n++;}report.push({at:[x,z],nativeHeight:r[4],profile:p,colliderParts:n});}console.log('[marina-outliers] '+JSON.stringify(report));})()

name: qcyc-appearance-batches
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP;const found=[];a.scene.traverse(o=>{if(/^Buildings_Marina/.test(o.name)){found.push({name:o.name,count:o.count});if(o.count<1)throw Error('Empty marina batch');}});if(found.length!==3)throw Error('Missing marina appearance batches '+JSON.stringify(found));console.log('[marina-appearance] '+JSON.stringify(found));})()

name: qcyc-source-canopy-check
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,s=C.islandResidentialCanopyEzStats,d=C.ISLAND_RESIDENTIAL_CANOPY_DATA;if(!s||s.residential!==33||s.marina!==18||s.added!==51)throw Error('Unexpected source canopy integration '+JSON.stringify(s));const ids=new Set(s.sourceIds);if(ids.size!==51)throw Error('Duplicate source trees');for(const r of [...d.rows,...d.marina.rows]){const p=s.sites.find(p=>p.oid===r[0]);if(!p||Math.abs(p.x-r[1]/10)>.001||Math.abs(p.z-r[2]/10)>.001||Math.abs(p.height-r[3]/100)>.001)throw Error('Source tree moved/height changed '+r[0]);}console.log('[marina-source-canopy] '+JSON.stringify({added:s.added,residential:s.residential,marina:s.marina,removedGeneric:s.generatedReconciled,sourceIds:s.sourceIds}));})()
